title: Argentina, Lionel Messi have had easiest World Cup path ever - literally
text:
Argentina is trying to become the first repeat men's World Cup champion in over 60 years, and the path so far has been favorable.
men's World Cup quarterfinal, with the chance to become the first repeat men's World Cup champion since Brazil did it in 1958 and 1962. There has been an overwhelming amount of Messi magic, to be sure, but La Albiceleste have also faced a historically favorable draw, according to ESPN's"Argentina's path to the semifinals : Algeria , Austria , Jordan , Cape Verde , Egypt , Switzerland ," MisterChip.
"The average ranking of Argentina's opponents is the highest of any team on the path to a semifinal in the ENTIRE history of the World Cup. "Argentina cruised through group-stage play, but it has not been smooth sailing in the knockout stage, despite Cape Verde and Egypt's below-average FIFA rankings.
First, Cape Verde gave Argentina everything they could handle in the Round of 32, resulting in one of the best matches of all time. Argentina escaped in extra time, but Cape Verde had a legitimate chance at a historic upset for large swaths.
Then, in the Round of 16, Egypt took a 2-0 lead over Argentina deep into the second half before Cristian Romero , Messi , and Enzo Fernandez found the back of the net to complete one of the best World Cup comeback victories you'll ever see.
